context: A boss mentors a uni intern
purpose: Teach: 人脈/吟味/分岐/社交/やり直し/斬新/持ち帰り/ごまかし

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、人脈、ビジネスの財産だ。
lines.en: Ren, networks are the real currency in business.
lines.style: Measured, settling into teaching mode. Warm authority — not lecturing from above but inviting him into the reality. Slight weight on 'currency.' Eyes steady.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。提案を吟味する時間、大切ですね。
lines.en: Yes. Taking time to really weigh proposals — that matters.
lines.style: Nod built into the first word. Thoughtful, not just agreeable. He's thinking as he speaks, not just reflecting. Slight hesitation before 'weigh' — he's choosing the right idea.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.en: The choices you make at those branching points — don't get them wrong.
lines.style: Sharper than before. Not unkind but firmer. Light pressure on 'get them wrong.' He's trusting Ren to hear the weight in this. Slight lean forward.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 社交スキル、社会人として身につけたいです。
lines.en: I want to develop those social skills — become someone who can actually do this job right.
lines.style: Quiet determination under the surface. Not performative enthusiasm. He's talking to himself as much as to Hiroshi. Slow, deliberate. Slight nervous energy held back.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 失敗のやり直し、若いうちに経験しろ。
lines.en: Learn to fail and bounce back while you're young enough to recover from it.
lines.style: Grave, measured. Not a threat but a hard-won truth. Slight pause before 'recover' — he's felt what failure costs. Even rhythm, no rush. Weight in the silence after.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 斬新な発想、若手の特権ですか。
lines.en: Is fresh thinking like that something young people get that others don't?
lines.style: Genuinely curious, testing the boundaries of what Hiroshi means. Not defensive — actually listening for the answer. Slight tilt of the head in the voice. Open.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 資料持ち帰り厳禁、ごまかしも、業界では命取りだ。
lines.en: No company documents leave your desk, and no cutting corners — both are company killers in this industry.
lines.style: Final word. Serious, no room for interpretation. Each clause lands with equal weight. Slight hardness creeping in because he means this. Eye contact doesn't break. Clean stop.
